# ConversionMap { #timetoalign.ConversionMap }

```python
ConversionMap(source_unit=None, target_unit=None, uid=None, name=None)
```

Abstract base class for coordinate conversion maps.

A ConversionMap transforms coordinates from one representation to another.
Maps are callable and support both scalar and array inputs.

The key methods are:
- __call__(value): Convert a single value or array
- inverse(): Get the inverse map (if invertible)

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                  | Description                                |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| id          | [str](`str`)                                          | Unique identifier for this map instance.   |
| source_unit | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| None | The unit of input coordinates (optional).  |
| target_unit | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| None | The unit of output coordinates (optional). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Create a map that doubles values
>>> linear = LinearMap(scalar=2.0)
>>> linear(5.0)
10.0
```

```python
>>> # Maps are callable
>>> linear(np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]))
array([2., 4., 6.])
```

```python
>>> # Get the inverse
>>> inv = linear.inverse()
>>> inv(10.0)
5.0
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [convert_array](#timetoalign.ConversionMap.convert_array) | Convert an array of values. |
| [from_dict](#timetoalign.ConversionMap.from_dict) | Deserialize a map from a dictionary. |

### convert_array { #timetoalign.ConversionMap.convert_array }

```python
ConversionMap.convert_array(values, **kwargs)
```

Convert an array of values.

This is the public API for array conversion, used by the timestamp
system and other batch operations. It delegates to _convert_array().

All ConversionMap subclasses support efficient array operations through
this method. Linear maps use NumPy broadcasting, TableMaps use np.interp,
and composite maps delegate to their sub-maps.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                     | Description                       | Default    |
|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| values   | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\] | NumPy array of values to convert. | _required_ |
| **kwargs | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                      | Subclass-specific arguments.      | `{}`       |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                                               |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\] | NumPy array of converted values with same shape as input. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> linear = LinearMap(scalar=2.0, offset=1.0)
>>> linear.convert_array(np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0]))
array([1., 3., 5.])
```

```python
>>> tempo_map = TableMap.from_tempo_changes([0, 960], [120, 60], 480)
>>> tempo_map.convert_array(np.array([0, 480, 960]))
array([0.  , 0.5 , 1.5])
```

### from_dict { #timetoalign.ConversionMap.from_dict }

```python
ConversionMap.from_dict(data)
```

Deserialize a map from a dictionary.

Dispatches to the concrete subclass named by ``data["type"]`` using
the self-registering class registry populated by
``__init_subclass__``. ``name`` may be left out; every other key the
map's own dictionary form writes is required. Every key that form
does not write is kept and written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|------------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Dictionary representation. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                          | Description               |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
|        | [ConversionMap](`timetoalign.maps.base.ConversionMap`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\] | A ConversionMap instance. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the type is missing or unknown, or a key other than ``name`` is missing.                      |
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If the registered class does not override from_dict, which would otherwise recurse indefinitely. |

### matches_selector { #timetoalign.ConversionMap.matches_selector }

```python
ConversionMap.matches_selector(key)
```

Return whether a user conversion-map selector addresses this map.

Subclasses that are addressed by other identifiers (for example,
InterpolationMap by its source timeline id) should override this
and extend the match.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                            | Default    |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| key    | [str](`str`) | A selector string from a conversion-map specification. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                               |
|--------|----------------|-------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if key equals this map's id or name. |

|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|------------|
| other  | [ConversionMap](`timetoalign.maps.base.ConversionMap`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The map to apply after this one. | _required_ |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.ConversionMap.to_dict }

```python
ConversionMap.to_dict(minimal=False)
```

Serialize the map to a dictionary.

Subclasses should call ``super().to_dict(minimal=minimal)`` and add
their parameters; rational parameters go through
:func:`~timetoalign.core.number_to_json` so that the whole
dictionary stays JSON-serializable.

``name`` is the name given at construction, or None when the map
displays a derived one; every subclass ``from_dict`` passes it back
to the constructor. Keys the library does not know, kept when the map
was read, are written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type           | Description                                             | Default   |
|---------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| minimal | [bool](`bool`) | Leave out ``name`` when it is None, in nested maps too. | `False`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                           |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Dictionary representation of the map. |
